dedupe_keys.name: cap strategic plans master file and farm practices data jrc datam

description: The CAP Strategic Plans master file compiles detailed information and data from the national strategic plans through which EU Member States implement the Common Agricultural Policy for 2023 to 2027. It covers the interventions and planned unit amounts for direct payments, such as basic income support, redistributive support, eco-schemes and coupled support; rural development, such as environmental and climate commitments, area-specific constraints, investments and risk management tools; and sectoral interventions for fruit and vegetables, wine and apiculture, plus result indicators, conditionality standards, minimum requirements and national top-up financing, both across all Member States and per country. A companion file labels farm practices in eco-schemes and agri-environment-climate measures by land use and livestock category. It is compiled by the European Commission's Joint Research Centre for research, especially to reflect the plans in agro-economic models. Coverage is the 27 EU Member States. The files are free XLSX downloads on the JRC DataM site. Caveats: they are not official documents, machine translation and extraction errors cannot be excluded, and Member States keep amending their plans. For simulation it supplies policy parameters for farm and agro-economic models used in climate adaptation and resilience studies of European agriculture. It is related to the MAGNET record in this catalogue, an agro-economic model that such data feed.
